criteria.description: Opens with an honest diagnosis of the central challenge / current reality before proposing actions, rather than jumping to solutions or goals.
States a non-obvious insight/belief that gives an edge, not a platitude everyone already shares.
Names a focused bet/where-to-focus AND explicit non-goals (what they will not do), rather than trying to do everything.
Explains how the advantage is defended / why it persists (a moat), not just how it differs.
The proposed bets/initiatives follow coherently from the diagnosis and insight rather than being a grab-bag.
Defines how success is measured and the key assumptions / what-must-be-true (risks).
